name: PlaNeRF
definition: An unsupervised 3D plane regularization method for NeRF that improves large-scale urban scene reconstruction by appending two regularization terms to the standard L2 photometric loss: a patch-based SSIM term for initialization and an SVD-based plane regularization term for geometry.
summary: PlaNeRF is an unsupervised NeRF method that improves urban scene reconstruction by using SVD-based plane regularization and semantic masking to enforce planar geometry on flat surfaces.
